2607.09590.title: PAC-ACT: Post-training Actor-Critic for Action Chunking Transformers
2607.09590.paper_summary: Precision industrial contact manipulation requires reliable robot policies under pose perturbations and contact-force constraints. Vision-language-action models offer broad generalization but often introduce high inference latency and GPU-memory cost, while vision-action chunking policies are more suitable for real-time industrial control. However, these policies are usually trained by behavior cloning and suffer from distribution shift in contact-rich tasks. This paper proposes PAC-ACT, a reinforcement-learning post-training framework for pretrained Action Chunking Transformer policies. PAC-ACT reformulates policy optimization at the chunk level, constructs an ACT-transferred actor-critic architecture, and introduces a hybrid behavior-prior constraint to preserve the pretrained action distribution during online fine-tuning. Experiments on industrial precision-contact benchmarks show that PAC-ACT improves task success, contact stability, and force safety while retaining low latency and low GPU-memory usage. On the Contour task, PAC-ACT significantly reduces peak contact force and decreases the proportion of force readings above 60 N by 46 times. Sparse-reward ablations further show that the proposed behavior-prior constraint enables effective exploration under randomized initial poses.
2607.09590.paper_summary_zh: 精確的工業接觸操作需要在姿勢擾動和接觸力限制下可靠的機器人策略。視覺-語言-行動模型提供了廣泛的泛化能力，但通常會引入高推理延遲和GPU記憶體成本，而視覺-行動分塊策略則更適合實時工業控制。然而，這些策略通常是通過行為複製訓練的，並且在接觸豐富的任務中遭受分佈轉移。本文提出了PAC-ACT，一種針對預訓練的行動分塊Transformer策略的強化學習後訓練框架。PAC-ACT在分塊層面重新定義了策略優化，構建了一個ACT轉移的演員-評論家架構，並引入了一種混合行為先驗約束，以在在線微調過程中保留預訓練的行動分佈。對工業精確接觸基準的實驗表明，PAC-ACT提高了任務成功率、接觸穩定性和力的安全性，同時保持低延遲和低GPU記憶體使用。在輪廓任務中，PAC-ACT顯著減少了峰值接觸力，並將超過60 N的力讀數比例降低了46倍。稀疏獎勵消融實驗進一步表明，所提出的行為先驗約束使得在隨機初始姿勢下的有效探索成為可能。
